implications.says: the cook has him in her kitchen, and the carter's word against hers is not to be believed: at half past eight he was in the kitchen
the cook and the curate, who share nothing, both have him in the kitchen at half past eight: he was there
the foreman was in the kitchen across the yard from eight till nine: he did not go into the counting-room
the bag went by the key, in the hour; the carter had the key in that hour and the foreman did not leave the kitchen: the carter took it
